Tired of writing boilerplate API wrappers and custom retry loops just to orchestrate your LLM workflows? 🤖⚡

Building advanced AI agents and multi-step pipelines shouldn't mean drowning in repetitive infrastructure code. Traditional low-code tools break down the moment you need real programmatic control, leaving developers stuck between rigid visual builders and starting from scratch.

n8n is the fair-code, node-based workflow automation platform designed specifically to bridge the gap between visual low-code speed and custom code power. 

Here is why backend devs and AI engineers are loving it:

🧠 AI-Native Orchestration: Build multi-step AI agents and seamlessly switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models without changing your architecture.
💻 Code When You Need It: Escape low-code limits by embedding custom JavaScript, Python, and npm packages directly into workflow nodes for heavy data manipulation.
🔌 Massive Ecosystem: Connect systems instantly using over 1,500 built-in integrations and 9,000+ ready-made templates.
🔒 Enterprise Self-Hosting: Deploy securely on your own infrastructure via Docker with full support for RBAC, audit trails, and sensitive data handling.

Stop wasting hundreds of hours on manual API integrations and state management. Use n8n as your orchestration layer to trigger webhooks, process payloads, and pass context straight to LLM tool-use agents.

Check out the repo, spin it up via Docker, and star it on GitHub:
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n

Stop building custom chat-to-agent glue code. 🛑

Meet agentes-chat (https://github.com/agentes-chat/agentes-chat), an open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative built natively for human and multi-agent collaboration. 

The Problem:
AI tooling is completely fragmented. Instead of treating AI as a sidebar bot or a single-player playground, engineering teams need a way to integrate LLMs directly into team channels as first-class workspace members with specific roles, budgets, and permissions.

What makes it a game-changer for developers and AI engineers:

🤖 Native Multi-Agent Collaboration: Let Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, and OpenRouter models join public and private channels, read context, self-route, and pass work back and forth with human team members.

🛡️ Safe-by-Default Controls: High-risk actions like git merges and deploys trigger interactive approval cards right in the chat. Plus, every model call is strictly budgeted and recorded per agent.

🔌 Comprehensive MCP Integration: Easily hook up Model Context Protocol servers, Composio for enterprise apps, dedicated agent browsers with live viewing, and Claude Code execution.

🐳 100% Self-Hosted & Portable: Deploy instantly via Docker and PostgreSQL with pgvector, run securely over Tailscale, and enjoy zero paid tier locks or license keys.

Built with a modern tech stack (Bun, Hono, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, React, TanStack, Expo, and Tauri), it is fully extensible for custom skills, routines, and automated dev workflows like automated CI/CD triage and real-time pull request reviews.

👉 Star and clone the repository today: https://github.com/agentes-chat/agentes-chat

Tired of awkward AI bots crashing your Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams calls just to take notes? 🛑

Meet Yogurt: a private, open-source desktop AI meeting notes app that runs 100% locally on your machine using Whisper and Llama.cpp. No invasive bots, no third-party cloud servers, and zero data leakage. 🔒✨

The Problem:
Most AI meeting assistants force you to invite a third-party bot into your calls, sending sensitive corporate and personal conversations straight to external cloud services. For developers and privacy-conscious engineers, that is a hard no.

How Yogurt Solves It:
Yogurt locally records both your microphone and system audio, transcribes your speech with Whisper, and generates sharp summaries using open-weight models via Llama.cpp—all completely offline.

Key Features:
🤖 Bot-free recording: Captures local audio without cluttering your meeting participant list.
💻 100% Local-first AI: Powered by whisper.cpp and llama.cpp, keeping all transcripts securely on your device.
🔌 Built-in MCP Server: Features a local Model Context Protocol server that gives external assistant apps read-only access to your meeting notes.
 cross-platform desktop app: Built with Electron for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows, and Linux.

For developers, Yogurt also serves as an incredible reference architecture for building local-first Electron apps that integrate complex C++ inference engines and expose secure data contexts via Unix sockets and named pipes.

Check out the repo, star the project, and take back your meeting privacy today:
https://github.com/FrigadeHQ/yogurt

Static recompilation techniques are pushing the boundaries of software preservation by translating console game binaries directly into native Windows C code without an emulator. 🎮🚀

Are you tired of the heavy performance overhead of traditional hardware emulation? 

Ocarina Recomp is a powerful static recompilation project that translates game binaries from a restricted console environment straight into native C code. It compiles them directly into a high-performance Windows executable paired with a modern Vulkan runtime graphics layer, allowing legacy titles to execute completely natively on PC hardware. 💻✨

🔥 Key Features:
• Direct Binary Translation: Uses custom scripts to translate native architecture binaries into clean ANSI C code for direct compilation.
• Advanced Graphics Bridging: Bridges proprietary graphics commands to standard Vulkan 1.3 with mesh shader support, converting low-level GPU shaders on the fly.
• Automated Workflows: Provides multi-step setup wrappers and scripts for verification, simulation, and local building straight from your own game files.

🛠️ Why Systems Programmers and Reverse Engineers Love It:
If you work in binary translation or software preservation, you can study this repository to master advanced translation pipelines, header-based lowering techniques for custom shader architectures, and runtime environments that map proprietary console APIs to modern Vulkan.

Explore the source code and start experimenting today:
https://github.com/sostenesfreitas/ocarina-recomp

Stop wasting hours digging through GitHub for the right Go packages! 🛑 Whether you are building high-throughput microservices or scalable cloud-native infrastructure, finding production-ready tools shouldn't be a guessing game.

Meet avelino/awesome-go—the ultimate community-curated directory of Go frameworks, libraries, and resources designed to accelerate your next backend project. 🚀

This repository solves the endless discoverability struggle in the Go ecosystem by maintaining an exhaustive, peer-reviewed list spanning dozens of technical domains—from Artificial Intelligence and Actor Models to Web Frameworks and Zero Trust security. 

Here is why it is a must-bookmark for every Go developer:
• Comprehensive categorization covering everything from HTTP routers and ORMs to database drivers and message queues.
• Continuous community maintenance and automated checks ensuring outdated or unmaintained packages get flagged and removed.
• Extensive learning resources including style guides, benchmarks, and free e-books to level up your architectural design.

Cut down your research time, eliminate architectural risk, and build with battle-tested libraries on your very next sprint. 

Check out the repository here:
